# Task Graph

The work toward parity with the original game, as a dependency graph: a
question about the original is answered before its review, the review
before the port, and the port before the comparison it fixes can pass.
These pages are generated from `.beads/issues.jsonl`, which the lead
session keeps with [br](https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/beads_rust);
[agent_docs/task-graph.md](../agent_docs/task-graph.md) explains the node
kinds and how work is claimed and closed.

262 nodes: 4 in progress, 164 open, 1 deferred, 93 closed.

> Replace the invented crates/rebellion-render/src/ground_combat.rs with the original flow: Planetary Assault in the fleet menu, immediate resolution, the Assault Summary window and its Message Index entry (agent_docs/roadmap.md, UIP-F-010, RE-GND-01; manual pp. 119-121). Eight Empire-side A0 references exist; no Alliance one.

<a id="or-ep-mod-surface-vdch"></a>
### Mod surface: map what the original fixes in code

`or-ep-mod-surface-vdch` · **closed** · 13 of 13 closed

> What the original fixes in code rather than data, so the port can open it to mods: Force users and their training, the story encounters (Luke/Vader, Vader/Palpatine), mission types, ship types and their art, the galaxy's size, and the movies. Each question ends in a note naming every constant, family check, fixed-size table and hand-coded id, with function citations, and says which of them a DAT or resource table already drives. The port's extension work (mods.rs `add` entities, data-driven encounters) follows from these notes and gets its own port nodes; questions here are worker-ok.
